name: Cervecería L'Abadìa
title: Cerveceria LAbadia
paragraphs: What is your answer to the question: what beer should I serve you? Yes it is: beer, beer. The normal one! So, you have to urgently go to L'Abadia. The world we live in is full of acronyms and anglicisms. And, the brewers of the 21st century have been able to take advantage of this trend to create products with such creative names as flying pigs or the bearded girl.

At L'Abadía, we are passionate about beer and that is why we have created a menu with a selection of unique craft beers, made with the best ingredients and with great care. We invite you to embark on a sensory journey through our most recognized styles, where each drink will transport you to a universe of sensations and flavors.
Enjoy the unmistakable flavour of Victoria Marengo and Victoria Vendeja, with a range of specialities that capture the essence of the city.
For lovers of intensity. Discover Victoria Marengo Negra, the exquisite dark beer with hints of coffee and cocoa, perfect for the most demanding palates.
For those looking for something fruity. Try Victoria Vendeja IPA, our India Pale Ale with a tropical hint of mango that will surprise you.
